Rock

⚡ High-Voltage Rock

  • AC/DC – You Shook Me All Night Long

  • The Killers – Mr. Brightside

  • Queen – Don’t Stop Me Now ⚡ (New Addition)

  • Fall Out Boy – Sugar, We’re Goin Down

  • Franz Ferdinand – Take Me Out ⚡ (New Addition)

  • Jet – Are You Gonna Be My Girl ⚡ (New Addition)

  • Def Leppard – Pour Some Sugar On Me

  • Bon Jovi – Livin’ on a Prayer ⚡ (New Addition)

  • Blur – Song 2 ⚡ (New Addition)

  • The White Stripes – Seven Nation Army ⚡ (New Addition)

  • Joan Jett – I Love Rock & Roll

🎸 Classic Rock & Bay Area Essentials

Timeless anthems and the soul of the 60s/70s.

  • Aerosmith – Lights / Walk This Way / I Don’t Wanna Miss a Thing

  • Beatles – A Hard Day’s Night / I Saw Her Standing There / Twist & Shout / When I’m 64

  • Bruce Springsteen – Born In The USA / Born To Run / Dancing In The Dark

  • CCR – Bad Moon Rising / Down on the Corner / Proud Mary / Susie Q

  • Rolling Stones – Beast Of Burden / Brown Sugar / Satisfaction / Honky Tonk Woman / Jumpin’ Jack Flash / Sympathy For The Devil

  • Santana – Oye Como Va / Smooth

  • The Doors – Roadhouse Blues

  • Eagle-Eye Cherry – Save Tonight ⚡ (New Addition)

  • Guns N’ Roses – Paradise City / Welcome To The Jungle

  • Journey – Don’t Stop Believin’

  • Led Zeppelin – Whole Lotta Love

  • Lynyrd Skynyrd – Sweet Home Alabama

  • Meatloaf – Paradise by the Dashboard Light

  • Steppenwolf – Magic Carpet Ride

  • Tom Petty – Saving Grace / American Girl ⚡ (New Addition)

🕶️ 80s New Wave & Retro Dance

The “Alternative” dance side of the list.

  • Depeche Mode – Just Can’t Get Enough / John The Revelator / Personal Jesus ⚡ (New Addition)

  • New Order – Bizarre Love Triangle / Blue Monday

  • Yazoo (Yaz) – Don’t Go / Situation

  • Talking Heads – Life During Wartime / Burning Down the House ⚡ (New Addition)

  • Billy Idol – Rebel Yell ⚡ (New Addition)

  • Erasure – Oh L’amour

  • Peter Gabriel – In Your Eyes

  • The Cure – Just Like Heaven ⚡ (New Addition)

  • The Police – Roxanne ⚡ (New Addition)

🌪️ 90s – 2000s Alternative & Nu-Rock

The heavy hitters and the indie-sleaze era.

  • Nirvana – Smells Like Teen Spirit

  • Red Hot Chili Peppers – Tell Me Baby / Stadium Arcadium / Especially In Michigan

  • Audioslave – Original Fire / Out Of Exile

  • Muse – Knights of Cydonia / Starlight

  • Gorillaz – Feel Good Inc. / Feel Good

  • Panic! At The Disco – I Write Sins Not Tragedies / The Only Difference…

  • The Strokes – You Only Live Once / Mercy Mercy Me

  • Arctic Monkeys – Fake Tales Of San Francisco / I Bet You Look Good On The Dancefloor ⚡ (New Addition)

  • Linkin Park – Waiting For The End / In The End ⚡ (New Addition)

  • Evanescence – Call Me When You’re Sober

  • AFI – Miss Murder / Love Like Winter

  • Papa Roach – To Be Loved / Getting Away With Murder

  • Disturbed – Land Of Confusion / The Animal

  • Avenged Sevenfold – Seize the Day / Walk / Welcome To the Family

  • Rise Against – Ready to Fall / Help Is On The Way

☕ Mid-Tempo, Indie & Groovy

For the start of the night or the transition sets.

  • Beck – E-Pro / Loser ⚡ (New Addition)

  • The Fray – Over My Head / How To Save a Life

  • Jack Johnson – Sitting, Waiting, Wishing

  • Paul Simon – You Can Call Me Al / Cecelia

  • Van Morrison – Brown Eyed Girl / Moondance

  • Gnarls Barkley – Who Cares? / Gone Daddy Gone

  • Snow Patrol – Chasing Cars

  • Death Cab for Cutie – I Will Follow You into the Dark

  • Plain White T’s – Hey There Delilah / Hate (I Really Don’t Like You)

  • UB40 – Red Red Wine

🔊 Hard Rock & Heavy Rotation

When the energy needs to peak.

  • AC/DC – Hells Bells

  • Korn – Got the Life

  • Lamb of God – Redneck

  • Mudvayne – Happy? / Forget To Remember

  • Seether – The Gift

  • Staind – King of All Excuses

  • Tool – The Pot

  • Shinedown – Heroes / Diamond Eyes

🎧 DJ Quick-Reference: The 2011 Set

  1. Cage The Elephant – Shake Me Down

  2. Linkin Park – Waiting For The End

  3. The Black Keys – Tighten Up

  4. My Chemical Romance – Sing

  5. Alter Bridge – Isolation

  6. Mumford & Sons – Little Lion Man

  7. Rise Against – Help Is On The Way

  8. Avenged Sevenfold – Welcome To The Family

  9. Shinedown – Diamond Eyes (Boom-Lay Boom)

  10. Disturbed – The Animal
